BASE GAME

Hello Brotatoes! We’re back with a first HEAVY balancing patch.

Since the release of Primal Dread, we’ve seen a lot of feedback around the balance of the game. We wanted to take some time before rushing into it so we tried our hand at balancing in beta first. And now it’s out for everyone!
Balancing Mecha that felt overpowered
Balancing Mutant that felt underpowered
Balancing the Jungle Nightmare experience
Adding more bans that comes during your run
Changing some frustrating character design like the Variant
Improving some items
Bug fixing and Quality of Life features
There’s still some work to do. We plan to address the balancing of weapons in an upcoming patch.
And once again, we need your feedback!

Alongside the Brotato: Primal Dread DLC (it just released, check it out here!), we are updating the base game with a new feature and some balancing brought to Nightmare and old characters.
Item Set
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/ac287784c908bf26484d119a5d9a4d5a54af3eb7.gif"]
In 1.2, we introduce a big new Quality of Life free feature, the Item Set. In this menu, you can activate or deactivate the entire content from extensions and free updates.

Want a vanilla feeling? Deactivate everything. Want to remove the Pets and keep the rest? Deactivate Paws&Claws and play with the other content. Do as you want, it's your decision. And isn't this game all about making decisions?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/1f0d087f05dabeced4770c25e889641a2a3fa884.gif"]
And the good thing is that you can quickly do it from the Character Selection menu! No time wasted in menus, more time playing Brotato!

After the release of Nightmare difficulty, we quickly had to switch our focus to Primal Dread and didn't take the necessary time to change this new difficulty. With the release of new content, we also wanted to introduce changes based on community feedback.
Balancing is an ongoing process and we appreciate any and all feedback you can give us to keep improving the game!

items.text: Hello everyone!
All Pain No Gain is here! And let me tell you, it's not for the faint of heart.
Before going into what's new about the update, a quick reminder if you missed it, we announced a new DLC for Brotato coming later this year! You can already add the DLC to your wishlist here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4498220/Brotato_Primal_Dread/"]
Now back to the serious stuff!

items.text: The game has been updated. Before playing, please make sure to unsubscribe from all out-dated mods.
Incompatible mods can cause your game to crash and your save data may become corrupted.
We recommend using only mods that clearly state their compatibility with this version of the game.
If you have any questions about that, do not hesitate to ask.

So, All Pain No Gain is live and its here to heat things up. We've seen that Danger 5, the highest difficulty of the game, was often regarded as the default way to play Brotato. So we thought the game was ready to receive a difficulty that offers a MUCH tougher challenge, and we humbly obliged...
Let's get into it!

If the name of the new mode wasn't enough of a clue, let me tell you that this is something far above Danger 5. Be prepared to lose over and over - All Pain, No Gain is the update name for a good reason.

Nightmare turns the numbers up. Enemies do more damage, have more health and are even faster than Danger 5. You'll also see some new enemies and new timeline events. To know more about those, keep reading!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/dfaf572ad08a31ba3ddfcb88853c036bf3b7bed4.png"]

To make sure you have what it takes to face this challenge, Nightmare difficulty is unlocked after 10 wins in Danger 5 on different characters (or on different maps if you own Abyssal Terrors DLC). If you already have the 10 wins, you don't have to do more, Nightmare will opens its harsh embrace to you!
But what makes Nightmare so dangerous? Well, there's a couple of new things you'll need to watch out for.

In Nightmare Difficulty, you'll sometimes have a special event, like Hordes and Elites. This is the environmental projectiles, where bullets are flying over the map for the duration of the wave. The arrow shape of the bullets should give you an idea of the path they're taking but stay on your toes and study the patterns!
And for more customization, if the environmental projectiles are too much for you or if you want more of them, we added an option to turn them off completely or have them on every wave. Your choice!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/e43f39bc7273bdb1d2e49cc007447c5cb532ad1c.png"]Find it in the Accessibility options.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/45c35ade68f2c5a56d89a6d463f1599d712b02ca.gif"]

Another event that will spice things up is the Fog. This will put some part of the map in the dark during a wave. Light will persist around you but the rest is in the dark, although your structures and pets will also light up. Oh and fire will definitely be useful here…

Tougher difficulty also means tougher enemies! We are introducing a batch of buffed up enemies based on existing foes. They are meaner, badder and more dangerous. But they will also feel like novelty before slashing you into bits.

Beating Nightmare will prove you're one of the best (or most stubborn). And to show the world you're the best of the best, you'll unlock a new character after one win in Nightmare, the Wounded.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/b7e952bbf7eaa199cbe92619f96cfd8d646a9687.png"]

This potato is the ultimate glass canon. You get a head start with more Harvesting and more Speed but die in 1 hit! Since we're nice people, you also start with a Tardigrade so you get 1 chance to make it further. And to focus entirely on making damage, this potato removes the items focused on defense from the shop and the crates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/bf8d98d345507afe05cabacc9393806d513e9076.png"]

You unlock the Rail Gun by winning a run with Wounded (in any difficulty). Just like you want to avoid getting hit with Wounded, you'll want to avoid getting hit when equipped with the Rail Gun. Because this weapons is getting stronger and stronger during a wave if you avoid damage.
Balancing

This update is centered around bringing more challenge to the game. But we wanted to take this occasion to make some balancing, mainly buffs, on old weapons that deserved some love. All changes can be found in the patchnote at the end of this post.
Small improvements
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//42320352/4d8f6fbd4a2173700c97a52543c1200cc53b9715.png"]
You can now see how you died! So that next time, you can get revenge on the alien that ended your perfect run!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//42320352/7a42c28fcaf3bc8d5385db21f7f32c3b3b97bb13.png"]

For owners of the Abyssal Terrors DLC, you now have the option of selecting a "Random" starting map. This way, you don't have to make a choice between Crash Zone and Abyss, destiny will make the choice for you.
A new character has to come with a new achievement!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/4d3a920347bf1c932a518d8c04be4ebbb1ee5174.jpg"]
Win a run on any map with the Wounded and you'll get a new achievement.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/9be8bd5b344ad893cbe5f2d25a12c9a67e0bbc44.jpg"]
Same for Nightmare difficulty, you'll need this achievement to prove you're a real tough Brotato!

That's it for All Pain No Gain! We know the content is all about bringing new challenge to the more seasoned players. For those of you who are fine with the current difficulty, we hope our work on the future DLC will bring the variety you're looking for.
In the meantime, tell us your thoughts on the update! Because there's always some changes that can be made based on your feedback!
Cheers, Dalloks and the EE team.

items.text: Hello everyone!
The time has come, the Paws & Claws Update is live!

notes.title: Here's a TLDR of the content, for full details keep reading

items.text: A new type of item: Pets
9 new Pets
1 new character, the Beast Master
QoL & Codex improvements
1 New achievement and new Steam Point items
And if you're more of a visual learner, we made a trailer for this update containing this new content in action. And is that.........an animated Brotato???
Technical note: Steam's video embedding is not fully functionable for all. If you don't see a full vide below this text, there should be a small hyperlink instead.

notes.title: Before getting into the content, an important warning about MODS

items.text: The game has been updated. Before playing, please make sure to unsubscribe from all out-dated mods.
Incompatible mods can cause your game to crash and your save data may become corrupted.
We recommend using only mods that clearly state their compatibility with this version of the game.
If you have any questions about that, do not hesitate to ask.
So, “Paws & Claws” is out, and if you have no idea what it's about, I'll tell you everything you need to know!
The last update was about improving the game experience while introducing very few new elements. This time however, we’re not holding back and released a new type of item, the Pets.
As you might have guessed, Pets are autonomous, friendly creatures that will fight alongside you. Think of it as a turret with more personality. And more flavorful effects.
And to go with it, we added 1 new character to get the most out of the Pets - the Beast Master!
Now, here’s the extended details with a bunch of explanation and pictures:

They gave the name to the update, they are the star of the show! Pets are friendly creatures that will help you fight or survive longer against the hordes of aliens. There are Pets for all types of builds, so you should find your happiness among the 9 new Pets that we are bringing to the game.
Pets are new, you might want to highlight them or see less of them when going into your Endless runs. You can change the highlighting and opacity of Pets in the accessibility options.
Like other items, Pets have to be unlocked. Here is the list of the items with their unlock challenges:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/dd90353a40019135cb1d35c0cf659c478ae70603.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/1a8989421605928529b51b686da2a82096ba69d6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/8328d2813fe4e05de54fc6f7dd4f75e7b025281e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/e28faa07aae3eedddd96190571f80b2a0b04a11f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/287b12040a77d28c39f9747219b7e76d0ab3cd29.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/2f07a0c2078ff0120d25ad47b60b3ae3c537c21b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/3c5e974d5a14be31992e0d452d7e8f8a205d1d8c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/f634ce66a5af19ce05b170a8e66540afdd82e2f7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/57bc824b153219a8062a032fbecf0645c64eab9d.png"]
Ratzilla: No unlock conditions.
Bonk Dog: Equip at least 6 weapons that scale with Melee Damage.
Catling Gun: Equip at least 6 weapons that scale with Ranged Damage.
Bot-O-Mine: Equip at least 6 weapons that scale with Engineering.
Blazemander: Equip at least 6 weapons that scale with Elemental Damage.
Doc Moth: Reach at least 10 HP Regeneration and +10% Life Steal in the same run.
Lootworm: Leave at least 20 materials on the ground at the end of a wave.
Jellyshield: Get hit by 3 enemy projectiles in one wave.
Scapegoat: Win a run with Beast Master.

Introducing Pets is all well and good, but we wanted to craft a potato with a special bond with them. That's why we are introducing the Beast Master - our first ever potato made by Evil Empire! This new free character is meant to play around the Pets and unlock their full potential. Try it out now!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/82ab0ed4e057cdb420cfe0310b20963971067031.png"]
To unlock the Beast Master, you must unlock the Bonk Dog, the Catling Gun, the Bot-O-Mine, the Blazemander and the Lootworm.
The idea behind the character is to fight solely with Pets. So, the Beast Master doesn't use weapons and instead uses his wild ways to make his pets super strong!
New timeline representation on pause menu.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/402619e016c3abb64cea1f933b3bc201a1f95fda.png"]
Now, when you pause during a wave, you will see at the bottom of your screen where you stand in terms of waves and upcoming threats! Visually helpful and practical.
Swimming animation in Abyss
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/a94f8f93f4a67c44ec067fa9f27f9c1ba4a1723f.gif"]
If you own the Abyssal Terror DLC, you’ll notice that Brotato does not walk but now swims. Because we figured that what was missing in a game potato with six floating hands was realism.
New info in the Codex
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/b3f21715bc4a6b38dc613cd7a4fe29b878f84cf1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/d591b91f25728f361e77eff8403cce2b9120b52d.png"]

Introduced in the lastest update, New Dawn, the Codex now includes better representation of enemies HP and speed as well as visual of their attack pattern. Because sometimes, images are worth a thousand words. For every change and addition, see the patch note at the end of the post.
New Achievement and Steam Point items
New Achievement
Okay so this was a tricky one. With the arrival of the Beast Master, we made the choice of adding 1 new achievement. We were hesitant at first. But every potato got 1, why not him?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/d9c3f62d0970b5c53b19bb182e67b31bb4f0f2ce.png"]
So there you have it, a new achievement unlockable by winning with Beast Master (on any map, base game or DLC)!
New Steam Point items
They are available! We've added new cool items in the Steam point shop!
Get Brotato stickers, animated avatars, animated profile background or customize your Steam Deck with a Brotato intro video!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/592e1b2e8f0b38c2c085aa60b92471c318427759.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/a19819a169e90f5a7771916375c56be88c879019.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/f2fe9cbb86b49a199e984fcb982d1465b56e5564.gif"]
WE NEED TO KNOW WHAT YOU THINK

That's pretty much all for Paws & Claws! The update is out but that doesn't mean it's the end. We still need to know what you think so that we can tweak, tinker and adjust. It's only our second update after all! So don't hold back!
Cheers, Dalloks & the EE team.

items.text: After 2 weeks on the beta branch, the New Dawn Update is going live!

Thanks to everyone who played our first beta session of the game. And a big thank you to the ones who took the time to share feedback. We’ve read all of it (yes, even that one), and we’ve learned a lot.

You’ve somehow managed to lift us up and humble us at the same time — which is a strange combo, but we kind of love it. Now the update’s out, so if we did things right, there’ll be more lifting. And if not, we are ready to be humbled.

PSA: We are sorry about this, but if you had started a run in the previous version then you will need to abandon that run, as the game will crash if you resume it. You may be able to finish it by reverting to the legacy branch. To do this go to the Steam Library page for Brotato, click on the cog/settings image on the right-hand side then Properties > Betas > legacy branch. Then you can come back to the new version once you've finished your run.

Behind this title — which might be a bit too presumptuous for its own good — New Dawn actually packs quite a lot of new stuff. We aimed for a solid quality-of-life update, plus a few extra features we felt you wanted.
The beta helped us hunt down a ton of bugs and fine-tune a few new items that… let’s just say weren’t quite ready for prime time.
If you're more a visual learner, we've put everything in a VLOG for you:
Even though our focus was QoL, we still wanted this update to have a little bit of meat on it, so we added 6 items and 1 weapon.
One item (fresh meat) is already unlocked. The others must be unlocked with an in-game achievement.

items.text: Vorpal Sword unlock: Reach +100% Crit Chance.
Have fun with those and let us know what you think! Now let's move on to the new extras...
This is something that we’ve seen wanted by many, so we are introducing a ban system to Brotato! You can now ban up to 8 items in the shop during your run.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/cbf2f0d4518c246a8939dd2936a3d9b9208e8465.png"]
To unlock the ban system, you have to win a run in Danger 3 or more.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/2d0b7aa9652943e4695aedaaf87c717f696b97df.png"]

Once unlocked, the ban system can be toggled on or off in the Run Options. We believe banning items is the way to go and that 8 bans per run is the sweet spot we’re looking for. The ban system was heavily discussed in the beta, but we are still looking forward to knowing what you think about that.
Brotato was always made with trials and errors, and we want to keep it like that, a game constructed in collaboration with its community!

You can now have 3 saves in Brotato. You can copy your progress onto another profile or reset the save. You can also unlock every item, characters, weapons and Danger level on a save (which will deactivate the earning of achievements, you’ll still have to get them the hard way).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/1875fef0abcb2a6bfbb4e617634c4f2ffb85a562.png"]

This allows you to have a fresh save and keep your old one, copy your ongoing profile to go endless while starting a run 20 on another profile, lend Brotato to your annoying sibling with different track progression, etc. Possibilities are endless (and by endless we mean within the bound of 3 profile slots)!
Codex
The Codex gathers the Progress menu and information’s about Items, Weapons and Enemies.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/c62e2d237745e3a97131a57d1bb8c01cb79c164d.png"]
Think of it as a wiki in the game with additional info like how many times you killed a specific alien and more!

items.text: We wanted to improve readability and make it faster to associate what items/characters works well with what stats. That way, you can make quicker decisions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/5790afb7cef36738c3f4c5891a3d4c7debf4e9fd.png"]
If it’s not to your liking (we spent some time on it but fair enough) this can also be deactivated in the Accessibility menu by turning off "Show effects icons", the choice is yours.
Already in the works under the Blobfish era, the game now supports Mac and Linux on Steam. Have fun with it!
We’ve added a lot of visual elements that fall into different categories.
Now, Chest and LvUp icons are merged when you gain more than 4 during a wave.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/f88c070d630eb4953daee04de82ae8bda1b93845.gif"]
We made some tweaks to curse and flames VFX to better set them apart (and we felt it was pretty). Plus, now you can distinguish your cursed turrets from the regular one.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/06eece6c3348b9921ebae425116d089573bbcc57.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/677328c50c110f57cafd79980f7305bc2b36bb20.gif"]

You’ll probably notice it quickly; we’ve added an animation for beginning and end of run. Look at that brotato, landing on hostile ground after his crash! Don’t worry, this animation does not make you lose any time (if speedrun is the kind of thing that gets you going).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/c7467725f1f85c421d8c91d07b553ac0786efc70.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42320352/e306922d252a6cd78206a0d9e75eb5271ad85f68.gif"]
Last but clearly not least, we’ve added a bunch of options for you to changes the colors displayed in the game. All of that is in the Accessibility menu.
For every change and addition, see the patch note at the end of the post.
Our first major contribution to Brotato is now in your hands. Play it, tear it apart, break the game and tell us what you think!

Like we mentioned in our Q&A, we did build a “Legacy” branch for those who would like to keep the Brotato version from before any Evil Empire update. Find it under “Properties” of your game in the beta tab.
Cheers,
Dalloks and the EE team.

Hello,

I just updated the demo with new content, balance changes and fixes! It features a new weapon combining system, weapon sets, 2 new traits, 32 new items, 4 new weapons, 2 new waves and more. (full patchnote below)
Thanks everyone for your feedback over these past weeks! I haven't been able to respond to all of you but I keep reading most of your messages and suggestions on the Steam forums and on Discord.

I'd also like to thank all of the content creators who have covered the demo! I've uploaded most assets of the game (items, weapons, characters, enemies) in the presskit in case you need them for your thumbnails.
When will be the full release?
No date yet but I'm hoping it'll happen in the next few months. Please add the game to your wishlist so you know when it's available!
How much will the game cost?
Somewhere between $2.99 and $4.99.
Will there be an endless mode?
Most likely yes, although a standard run will be 20 waves long.
Will there be meta-progression?
You will be able to unlock new items, weapons and traits by completing challenges/achievements in the game. (similar to Space Gladiators / Isaac)
Will there be Chinese?
Yes.
